model: Direct complex matrix indexed by the last two input tokens; all other prefix content is ignored in this pair-model pilot. Class codes exp(2*pi*i*c/vocab) depend only on vocabulary IDs. Unit entry disks and operator norm <= R. No task name, arithmetic operator, inverse or target rule enters features. Ordinary full-vocabulary cross-entropy.
solver: Full batch: projected gradients of the summed empirical CE, step 1. Mini: shuffled original batches with short tails, summed batch gradient and step 1/sqrt(1+update/updates_per_epoch). Forward-only: four scalar CE evaluations per sample produce central finite differences in real and imaginary coordinates, followed by the same projection and step 1; no analytic derivative or backprop. This is a different forward-only algorithm from the earlier exact consistency learner.
projection: Frobenius Dykstra between complex unit disks and SVD singular-value clipping. Stop on max-entry iterate change and disk violation <= tolerance, or cap. Recompute final norms and radially shrink by max(1, max_entry, opnorm/R) to ensure feasibility within floating-point error; report every cap and shrink. No claim of exact projection or certified optimization gap.
evaluation: Frozen source split hashes and metric implementation; original evaluation cadence, with endpoints additionally measured. Fixed update budgets, no stopping on held-out accuracy. Report every outcome, training CE, projected-gradient residual, feasibility, saved-model replay and first >=99% observation.
interpretation: 27-cell prospective pilot on three previously failed pair tasks. Not an all-35 result or a matched transformer comparison. SpectralBall Lean proves convexity and the binary 2x2 recovery case only; it does not prove modular generalization or finite-step convergence. Three radii are fixed without inspecting missing labels. CPU complex LAPACK SVD and BLAS, one thread per process.
